in_tamil.long_meaning: The Three Realms of Gods, Humans, and Demons

in_marathi.name: Trilok
in_marathi.long_meaning: Trilok हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Trilok represents the three worlds - the physical world, the astral world and the spiritual world. It is a name of significance for those who believe in the interconnectedness of all things and seek to live a balanced life in all three realms.
